title: Prix Malin — Merchant Offer
description: Normalized offer record for a product listing obtained from an authorized source. This schema does not itself provide or verify live prices.

offer_id.description: Stable identifier from the authorized source, or a locally generated stable ID.

gtin.description: EAN/GTIN when supplied by the source; preserve as text.

tracking_url.description: Authorized affiliate URL, only when the relevant program has approved the publisher.

source.description: Name of the authorized API, feed, or merchant agreement.

shipping_price.description: Null when shipping cost is unknown.

total_price.description: Only set when product price and all mandatory shipping costs are known.

last_updated.description: Timestamp when this offer was last checked or the source says it was updated.
